visual_brief: Merdeka 118 has a slender blue-glass shaft with diamond-shaped facets, an asymmetric crown and an exceptionally long spire. Elevated views across Kuala Lumpur or the adjacent stadium precinct reveal its recognizable silhouette. Distinguish it from the paired Petronas Towers, bulb-headed KL Tower and boxy Exchange 106.
notes: Seven verified photographs retained. Preferred: c7; daylight alternative: c1. All exceed 2400 px on the long side. Individual framing limitations are noted below.
